==Dialogue==
{{Dialogue Start}}
:'''Nado:''' I'm done. Inspiration's as elusive as the moon in the sky, and I'm just a headless seaweed adrift in the ocean...
:{{DIcon}} What's wrong?
:'''Nado:''' I'm... I'm the traveler without shoes, stumbling down a path to inspiration that's nothing but thorns... cough!
:'''Nado:''' Alright, I'll confess. The truth is I just can't seem to write a thing.
:'''Nado:''' I've got a handful of half-baked manuscripts, but none of them capture the life of the Blessed Maiden.
:'''Nado:''' How did she grow up, and what aspirations did she set for herself? How were her studies in the seminary, and how did she pursue her dreams?
:'''Nado:''' I'm at a loss. I can't even figure out the ending for this script. I talked with the captain about it earlier, and he's just as stumped.
:'''Nado:''' Recently, I received a mysterious package. The captain says it's a private collection from the Fisalia family. No idea who sent it, but they must have had a soft spot for me...
:'''Nado:''' After reading, I felt like I was on the verge of piecing it all together. But inspiration's like a shooting star. Every time I reach for it... poof! It slips through my fingers.
:'''Nado:''' I don't know what to do! Perhaps I am just a seaweed. Brainless, drifting with the tide...
----
;(After {{Quest|Dawn Breaks on Dark Tides}})
:'''Nado:''' I'm done. Inspiration's as elusive as Cetus the Tidebreaker, and I'm just a headless jellyfish adrift in the ocean...
:{{DIcon}} What's wrong?
:'''Nado:''' It's like the traces of Cetus the Tidebreaker are all over these waters, yet all I can do is chase their wake, never glimpsing the grand, graceful form itself.
:'''Nado:''' Alright, truth is, there are too many ideas swirling in my head. I can't pin one down to begin the story. 
:'''Nado:''' You know, lately, reality has outstripped even the boldest plays I could dream up.
:'''Nado:''' How is that even possible? I feel like a starving sailor locked in a room full of fish.
:{{DIcon}} What if you wrote them all down?
::'''Nado:''' Race against my own inspirations? I'd just end up stuck here, staring at a blank page.
:{{DIcon}} Then throw them all out and find new ones.
::'''Nado:''' Can a jellyfish turn into a human? Alas, that's about as likely as me doing what you said.
:{{DIcon}} I've got some first-hand material for you.
::'''Nado:''' What? Out with it! I'll write as you speak, though I might add a touch of polish here and there...
:'''Nado:''' Well then, I'll start. I just need to get something on paper before I worry about whether it's beautifully written.
:'''Nado:''' Ahh, my brain's running dry again! O fleeting inspirations, bless me with another kiss!
{{Dialogue End}}
